In summary, our research is concerned with
the perception of the external environment by the management of Delta Corporation Zimbabwe, a company that is listed on the Zimbabwe Stock Exchange.

the measurement of business confidence in Zimbabwe's external environment using qualitative accounting information contained on the financial reports of a company listed on the Zimbabwe Stock Exchange (ZSE), Delta Corporation Limited Zimbabwe.

the measurement of business confidence in an external environment in Zimbabwe using qualitative accounting information contained within the annual financial reports of a Zimbabwean company, Delta Corporation Limited, from 2008- 2014.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the external environment in which Delta Corporation Limited operated between the years of the multicurrency regime was stable.
the external environment in the period under review was conducive and business was generally optimistic about its future in Zimbabwe.
the external environment in which Delta Corporation Limited Zimbabwe operated was stable and conducive for business in 2014, a year post the general election of 31 March 2008.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the perception of the external environment in the Zimbabwean business community may be better captured through qualitative accounting information than the questionnaire methodology.
the qualitative accounting information methodology is a better measure of business confidence in Zimbabwe than the survey methodology.
business confidence in Zimbabwe is a reflection of how well a company is doing in the absence of a macroeconomic crisis.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the perception of the business confidence in the environment in Zimbabwe is a dynamic and complex issue.

qualitative accounting information may be a better measure of perception of business confidence in a company's environment than the survey methodology employed by various research agencies in Zimbabwe.

business confidence may be a function of how well a business is performing and that it may be a function more of how well a company is performing than the external social political environment in which it operates.
